{{Top|leg}}
The '''Crosstown Bar''', also known as '''Crosstown''', was a tavern that located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]]. It operated during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==History==
Following the [[Battle of Kromus/Legends|Battle of Kromus]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a number of people gathered in the Crosstown Bar to watch a broadcast on the tavern's [[Holoprojector/Legends|holoprojector]], where the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] issued a statement of regret about the large-scale loss of life during the battle.
